finding.claim: Unauthenticated insecure deserialization: Marshal.load on attacker-supplied base64 data from the `state` param allows gadget-chain remote code execution.
finding.source: POST /restore params[:state] (any remote client, no auth)

trace.note: params[:state] base64-decoded and passed directly to Marshal.load, no signature/HMAC or type restriction
result inspected and returned; deserialization already executed gadgets

finding.guards_checked: No authentication, no signature/integrity check, no allowlist of classes, no before filters or middleware in the file (only app.rb exists). Sinatra does not sanitize params for this.

verdict.reason: app.rb:6 passes Base64.decode64(params[:state]) straight into Marshal.load in the unauthenticated `post "/restore"` route (app.rb:5), and app.rb is the only file, so there is no auth, signature check, class allowlist or middleware.
